scoped_dependency_policy: Shared dispatcher/observer/file steps can be instantiated for each selected capability or supplied by equivalent exact accepted handoffs. A provider-specific witness neither blocks nor certifies unrelated providers.

worker_selection_policy.objective: Lowest expected whole-run cost consistent with reliable completion, including context, reasoning, retries and review; not lowest price per token alone.
worker_selection_policy.availability_source: Enabled collaboration.spawn_agent model/effort declarations in this session; recheck before execution.
worker_selection_policy.pricing_basis: OpenAI API Standard, short-context text, USD per1M tokens; comparison aid only, not Codex subscription usage or a cost forecast.
worker_selection_policy.ultra_policy: No worker receives Ultra solely because the task is long or belongs to a multi-agent plan. Re-select only when that worker becomes a warranted coordinating multi-agent procedure under the skill; no coordinator model is changed here.
token_controls: Provide the selected task, exact released contracts, relevant source/evidence and expected cases instead of repeating full chat/repository history.
Keep raw evidence in files and pass paths/digests plus short status receipts.
Split clerical collection or scripted execution only where the full authority/semantic scope remains with a qualified worker.
Reuse pinned context within a lane; serialize shared-file authors rather than launching duplicate implementations.
Escalate conceptual ambiguity promptly; do not repeat unchanged failed attempts.
worker_selection_policy.fallback: When GPT-6.1 Sol is unavailable, use available GPT-6 Sol at the same approved effort. Recheck actual dispatcher/prices; missing required capability remains a readiness gap rather than silently lowering acceptance.
worker_selection_policy.measurement_limit: No per-task completion-token benchmark exists. Recommendations are task-risk judgments, not proven global optima.
